note: Only the per-round buffer-fill loop was ported to C (uuma_native.mix_buffer); the hashlib.scrypt() calls inside the phase are unchanged in both variants, since scrypt is already a C call into OpenSSL via CPython's _hashlib. Profiling showed the buffer-fill loop and the scrypt calls were roughly comparable in cost (~1ms each of ~1.87ms total) before this change, so speedup on the buffer-fill loop alone translates to a partial, not full, speedup on the phase.
